lede: GT Auto Garage is a car workshop at WCEGA Plaza in Bukit Batok. Its own website lists servicing, engine and transmission rebuilds, brakes and suspension, aircon work and pre-purchase inspections.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention easy online booking with reminders, clear explanations without hard selling, prices agreed before work starts, quick servicing and a fast fix for a door handle that came loose.
faqs: What does GT Auto Garage do?
Google Maps lists it as a car repair workshop.
The hours are listed in the Google Maps section above. Please see Google Maps for current hours.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, gtautogarage.sg.
specialties: Pre-purchase inspection with a written report
makes_note: Named on its own website, which says it works on all makes and models.
good_to_know: Appointments can be booked on its website
Payment by credit or debit card, cash or digital payment, according to its website
